claim: Candidate S (Structured Forecaster) achieves 12.95 mg/dL trajectory MAE on held-out patients, outperforming baseline B3 GBDT (22.00 mg/dL)
Candidate S achieves 16.32 mg/dL Peak Error, compared to 28.53 mg/dL for B3 GBDT
Candidate S achieves 0.81 Clarke Error Grid Zone A (CEGA), outperforming B3 GBDT (0.69)
Candidate S with physiological gamma absorption head outperforms Unstructured Candidate U (MAE 15.65 mg/dL)
Few-shot Ridge personalisation (K=5 historical meals) reduces trajectory MAE from 12.95 mg/dL to 8.92 mg/dL
Split-conformal prediction intervals achieve >=95% empirical coverage on held-out test trajectories under nominal D0 conditions
Under severe CGM dropout (Scenario D1), empirical coverage remains at 94.4% while mean interval width expands from 53.6 to 61.2 mg/dL
Degradation scenarios D0-D7 systematically evaluate stress resilience and trigger appropriate Reliability levels (HIGH, MODERATE, LOW)
Aegis is a research prototype, not a medical device, diagnostic tool, or treatment recommender
Synthetic EHR records are deterministically generated and strictly flagged with is_synthetic: true
CGMacros dataset contains 14 T2D participants from California; Indian meals are modeled via source-labelled presets with support checks
Counterfactual what-if simulations are explicitly partitioned into model-driven vs assumption-driven modifiers
